name: NEWBORN
title: Monumenti i gjallë
description: NEWBORN është atraksion turistik, vepër arti dhe monument i gjallë kombëtar. Konsiderohet shenjë e famshme identifikuese e Kosovës. E krijuam më 2008, e ngjyrosim ndryshe çdo vit.

projects.title: NEWBORN 18
projects.description: 2026 – FREEDOM. NEWBORN as a visual narrative of Kosovo’s journey toward statehood, opened through the liberation war and crowned with the building of an independent state.

data.content: As every year, the NEWBORN monument does not stand merely as an installation, but as a living voice of the people. It speaks through colors, shapes, and messages that reflect our reality, our challenges, hopes, rebellion, and love for our country.
Everything prepared in recent days carries within it deep love, tireless dedication, and extraordinary creativity.

This year’s concept presents NEWBORN as a visual narrative of Kosovo’s journey toward statehood; a path opened through the war for freedom led by the Kosovo Liberation Army and crowned with the building of the institutions of an independent state.

The values embodied in the liberation struggle of the Kosovo Liberation Army, such as endurance, bravery, obligation, tireless work toward recovery, and new beginnings, remain today the moral foundation of Kosovo’s state-building process and its international orientation.

In this context, this year’s theme is also connected to the 250th anniversary of the United States of America, one of the key allies that supported Kosovo’s fight for freedom and its state-building process.

The seven letters of the word NEWBORN symbolize seven values that reflect Kosovo’s journey from the liberation war to state-building and its international role. These values are visually expressed in each letter:

N — Nationhood 
Visualized through interconnected layers in different colors, symbolizing the construction of the state from surfaces that form a functional whole.

E — Endurance 
Visualized through concentric tree rings, representing the passage of time and resilience.

W — Work 
Visualized through interconnected mechanical forms, symbolizing work, effort, and cooperation as the foundation of state-building.

B — Bravery 
Visualized through a simple, abstract flame as a symbol of the courage to confront injustice and assume historical responsibility.

O — Obligation 
Visualized through continuous knots (joined hands), symbolizing moral responsibility toward one another, toward society, and toward the future.

R — Resilience 
Visualized through repaired fractures, inspired by the Japanese Kintsugi technique (repairing broken objects with gold), symbolizing added value—showing that Kosovo’s challenging journey makes its independence even more precious.

N — New Beginnings 
Visualized through leaves opening toward the sky, symbolizing renewal, hope, and orientation toward the future.
Beside the two letters N stands this year’s dedication:
“Dedicated to Kosovo, its journey toward freedom and state-building through the liberation war, and the shared values with the USA as the key ally in supporting this freedom.”

projects.title: NEWBORN 17
projects.description: 2025 – N0W. A reflection on artificial intelligence infiltrating daily life, and the intersection of technology and humanity.

data.content: Are our lives heading toward crystallization, losing their emotional essence and detaching from authentic human experience? Or are we, instead, becoming part of a revolution?

Artificial intelligence has quietly infiltrated our daily lives, shaping nearly every aspect of our existence. Its presence leaves invisible traces that refuse to fade, propelling us toward an uncertain future.

This year, we once again came together to paint New Born, building on this powerful theme and introducing a new monument concept for Prishtina. The 2025 New Born is dedicated to this very vision—a reflection of our ongoing journey as we navigate the intersection of technology and humanity.

The monument visually featured organic flowers – full of life, vibrant with color, and brimming with potential. From these organic flowers, digitalized electric lines, known in computer language as “motherboard lines,” branched out. "Motherboard lines" are the electrical pathways that connect parts of the processor and the entire internal system of the machine. This symbolism reflects how the digitalized world—artificial intelligence—has infiltrated the living world, pushing us from the natural into the synthetic, from life into machine, and paving the way toward a new digital world and an unknown journey.

In this context, the arrangement of flowers within the letters will create waves, much like the waves of the sea, symbolizing the continuity of this change, the flow of life, while also reflecting the waves of technology that set the rhythm for this transformation.
Flowers are not accidentally the central figure, as, since ancient times, they have represented love, passion, hope, peace, gratitude, and life itself.
This year also provides an opportunity to raise public awareness about the digital world.

projects.title: NEWBORN 16
projects.description: 2024 – 7 skies. Eight years after the barbed-wire sky of isolation, the sky is free—filled with silhouettes of European landmarks and endless opportunity.

data.content: In 2016, NEWBORN was wrapped in barbed wire painted sky blue to express indignation toward Europe for leaving Kosovo in isolation, after granting visa liberalization to all neighboring countries.

Now, eight years later, the sky is free. The sun at its zenith casts light on the silhouettes of iconic buildings from major European cities. The shadowy outlines of these monuments adorn each letter, capturing the serene dawns of Italy, the bustling days of Paris, the electric nights of Lisbon, and other well-known landmarks from cities and coastal places across the continent. This portrayal of the skies is not just about travel—it symbolizes the dawn of endless opportunities for every citizen. It represents infinite potential for self-fulfillment, diverse travel experiences, educational prospects, improved healthcare opportunities, cultural exchange, and connections with people from all walks of life.

The vast expanse of the sky, a recurring motif in this monumental artwork, symbolizes freedom and infinity. The sky becomes a metaphor for a connection to something greater than oneself—a sacred space that invites everyone to dream, explore, and embrace the limitless opportunities that lie beyond the horizon.

projects.title: NEWBORN 15
projects.description: NO NEW B(roken) R(epublic). A provocative theme marking another significant crossroad toward the statehood of Kosovo.

data.content: Every year, without exception, NEWBORN has delivered a strong message, every year marking the development of Kosovo in its road towards becoming a country that each Kosovan dreams of.
Every year, without exception, NEWBORN has delivered a strong message, every year marking the development of Kosovo in its road towards becoming a country that each Kosovan dreams of.

This year's theme is no different. In fact, it is provocative, perhaps, more than other times, but as always it is current with the situation in which our people and our country are, and it is yet another significant crossroad towards the statehood of Kosovo.

projects.title: NEWBORN 14
projects.description: 2022 – Winged Women. A reminder of perseverance and empowerment, addressing the maltreatment of women while celebrating their successes.

data.content: NEWBORN this year stood as a constant reminder of perseverance, strength, and grit. This year, Newborn addresses the maltreatment of women, through the defining lens of honesty, yet positivity, support, and empowerment, while also commemorating the vast successes of our women in different fields.
A global issue at that, the maltreatment of women while at the forefront of the fight for gender Equality; continues to turn into a schism, with every passing conversation.

The front of NEWBORN is painted with pictures of women of all different races, ages, forms, and affiliations, continuing to further our message of being one, yet while embracing our stark differences. The W however, is painted in white wings, a soaring message of spirit, strength and the faith to be in charge of your body and destiny. The faces of the women on both sides of the wings, will be looking toward the wings, a message of freedom.

The back of NEWBORN, is painted black, in commemoration of the pain that women go through, with the wings being on the back serving as a continuous reminder of the journey to be
set free. Wings on both sides will serve as a photography spot.
NEWBORN will continue to push for the recognition of women, and their experiences, as positive, or violating they might be, as showcased by our work of the year 2019, and as such we strongly believe this year will be a step in the right direction to stir up a conversation on valuing
women beyond their experiences.

projects.title: NEWBORN 13
projects.description: 2021 – WE BROUGHT PEACE TOGETHER. Citizens painted their palms in army colors onto the monument as a sign of respect and unity.

data.content: At a time when our dignity and struggle for freedom are being violated as never before, it is the last moment for all of us to come together and show the world that we all participated in bringing peace, with a lot of sacrifice.
It was the war that changed everything and made it possible for us to live free today. We once paid dearly for it, so today we consider it sacred

This year we all came together again, to show the world, as in the day when independence was declared, when we all left our signature on the monument, that we are unanimous in supporting the sacrifice of all those who gave their lives for us to live in peace.

We invited the citizens to paint their palms with one of the colors of the army and place it on the monument as a sign of respect, love and support for our war, so the NEWBORN Monument has the appearance of an army uniform, created by the hands of the citizens themselves.

projects.title: NEWBORN 12
projects.description: 2020 – Never Ending Wars. Dedicated to all the victims of sexual abuse during conflicts around the world.

data.content: Dedicated to all the victims of sexual abuse during conflicts around the world.

Today, as conflicts rage in different places, their mostly female victims are continuously being abused sexually, or suffering the post-conflict prejudice and difficulties being accepted in the society.

Visually, 2020's NEWBORN is painted mostly in black, representing the devastation and the void every war leaves behind. The letter W is covered with hope and freedom, representing the fragile, yet resilient character of every victim, surviving and overcoming their struggles together, while reaching out beyond the W (War, Women, World).
The burst of positivity and hope stretches to the neighbouring letters E and B, spreading across other letters, representing the slow, yet inevitable fact that goodness will prevail.

Each of the black letters contains short, touching stories or sentences that have been gathered from the victims of abuse during the 1999 war in Kosovo, in both English and Albanian. These extracts have been published previously, depicting their horrid accounts and graphic recollections. Our aim was to make people aware of the horrific experiences these victims were forced to go through.
Verbally, NEWBORN becomes an acronym (or rather an acrostic poem), where each letter is the beginning of a word, completing a sentence, written on both sides of the monument.

Never
Ending
Wars
Bring
Oppression,
Rape and
Neglect

projects.title: NEWBORN 11
projects.description: 2019 – Preserving Earth. Dedicated to the environment, with each letter representing an element crucial to preserve nature.

data.content: Air pollution has been an ongoing issue in Kosova for decades now, and hardly anything is done about it. Prishtina often tops the list of the most polluted cities in the world, but no action is being taken to eradicate the problem caused by the coal power plant nearby and the abundance of cars.
The 2019 NEWBORN was dedicated to the environment, since the global warming has been an ongoing issue worldwide and Kosova remains part of the problem, desperately seeking a solution.
We used doodles, a unique and trendy illustration style, to draw elements differently in every letter, with the help of many young graffiti artists and volunteers that took part in the process.
Each letter represented an element crucial to preserve nature. Hence both letters N in the beginning and the end of the monument represented Nature itself, creating an outer circle of life.

E for Energy and R for Recycling made another circle representing human inventions, whereas W for Water and O for Oxygen created the inner circle as the two essential elements for life, leaving the B for Biodiversity in the middle of these three circles, representing life itself.
Each letter had a written explanation of its meaning at the back of the monument.

projects.title: NEW10RN
projects.description: 2018 – The Decade. Letter B became 1 beside O to form number 10, painted gold for the 10th Independence Anniversary.

data.content: Prior to celebrations of the 10th Anniversary of Independence, NEWBORN was temporarily removed for maintenance, a few days before 17 February 2018.
Layers of paint throughout the years were removed and corroded areas were treated, ready for the new look.

Letter B was replaced with number 1, forming number 10, when placed next to the letter O. Then, number 10 was painted gold and the rest of the letters were painted silver, giving the monument a glamorous look for the 10th Independence Anniversary.

projects.title: NEWBORN 9
projects.description: 2017 – Breaking the Walls Down. Letters N and W were brought down to write NO WALLS, calling for an end to segregation.

data.content: Years 2016 and 2017 marked some global and domestic events that, instead of bringing people together, suggested that walls should be built, keeping them apart.
In response to all the walls of this kind in the world, and the recent wall being built in Mitrovica, NEWBORN's message was innovative, creative, clear and to the point.
While the major part of the structure, painted as a wall, stood erect, letters N and W were brought down, laying horizontally.
When looked at from a normal perspective, _E_BORN represented a broken wall, calling for the end of segregation all over the world.
This enabled us to write NO WALLS on the floor, using the laying letters N and W, thus conveying the message when seen from the top.

projects.title: NEWBORN 8
projects.description: 2016 – Isolation. Barbed wire preventing people from reaching for the sky—a call against keeping Kosova isolated.

data.content: Contrary to the previous years' designs, expressing gratitude to the world for helping Kosova declare independence, the 2016 NEWBORN expressed its discontent towards the world for not opening up to the new country.

Despite continuous efforts to build a respectable state, Kosovars were still kept isolated from the rest of the world. The barbed wire preventing the people to reach for the sky was a call to the world, urging it to find a solution.

projects.title: NEWBORN 7
projects.description: 2015 – Express Yourself. Everyone was invited to write, draw and express themselves on NEWBORN.

data.content: Remembering the very first NEWBORN, where people expressed their thoughts by writing on it with permanent markers, 2015 edition went further with the idea.
Everyone, children and adults alike, were invited to write, draw and express themselves in NEWBORN.
Paint was provided and for two straight days for hundreds of people, who created the most chaotic and amazing artwork, that would last only for a few hours, until someone else modified it.

projects.title: NEWBORN 6
projects.description: 2014 – Remembrance. Camouflage patterns from NATO armies and a tribute to the Kosovo Liberation Army.

data.content: Year 2014 marked the 15 years of freedom, following the war of 1999. To commemorate that, NEWBORN got dressed up in camouflage.
Each of the letters were painted with a different pattern, worn by a different NATO army, to express the gratitude for the sacrifice of these brave men and women who helped liberate Kosova.

Most importantly, the entire monument was a tribute to Kosova Liberation Army (UÇK), the ground force during the war, in remembrance to the heroes who gave their lives, and the living for their contribution to the country and its people.

projects.title: NEWBORN 5
projects.description: 2013 – Recognition. Citizens painted the flags of countries that recognized Kosova’s independence for the 5th anniversary.

data.content: Although NEWBORN was supposed to be painted every year, it took five years for it to change its look for the first time, in 2013. This was due to the negligence by the government to formulate a clear plan and devise a process of the maintenance of the monument.
As a result, the citizens took the matter into their own hands, to execute the initial idea of painting the flags of all the countries that recognized Kosova's independence.
The response was massive. Thousands of people loved the idea when presented on social media, and many offered themselves to help with the painting, tools and funding for this project.
It took over 100 volunteers to complete this task within 24 hours, working overnight to finish painting the flags on time for the dawn of 17 February 2013, celebrating 5 years of independence.

Thousands of people who went out in the streets of Prishtina to celebrate the Kosova’s 5th Independence Anniversary visited the NEWBORN Monument, announcing, once again, that this was the highlight of the festivities.

projects.title: Më i madh se vetë  jeta
projects.description: Vetëm 11 ditë para se të ndodhte, ne na erdhi një ide që do ta ngjallte edhe më shumë festimin e ditës më të madhe të historisë së vendit - Shpalljen e Pavarësisë së Kosovës.

data.content: Vetëm 11 ditë para se të ndodhte, ne na erdhi një ide që do ta ngjallte edhe më shumë festimin e ditës më të madhe të historisë së vendit - Shpalljen e Pavarësisë së Kosovës. Sfida ishte që të bënim diçka që nuk do ta acaronte turmën, por që do të shërbente për ta ngazëllyer atë, duke e shënuar këtë ditë historike.

E zgjodhëm fjalën NEWBORN për t'i kapluar, në një fjalë të vetme, të gjitha ato që ia binte pavarësia vendit tonë. Ne qëllimisht përdorëm fjalën në gjuhën angleze, të kuptueshme edhe nga njerëz që nuk e flasin mirë atë gjuhë, për ta përçuar porosinë në tërë globin, duke treguar për shtetin më të ri që po lind.

Krijuam një skulpturë me fjalën NEWBORN (nga anglishtja "i posalindur"), të ndërtuar nga një skelet çeliku i mbuluar me shtresë metali 4mm të trashë. Çdo shkronjë është 3 metra e lartë dhe 1 metër e thellë, me peshë prej përafërsisht 1 tonelate.
E ngjyrosur me ngjyrë të qëndrueshme metali dhe rezistente ndaj shumë elementeve. I tërë instalacioni është 24 metra i gjerë.
Pastaj, e kthyem këtë në skulpturë interaktive, për ta shënuar këtë rast me një simbolikë që do të ishte pjesë e kremtimeve dhe njerëzve përreth kësaj vepre.
Kjo do të përdorej si një mjet ku njerëzit do ti shprehnin emocionet e tyre duke shkruar me flomasterë permanentë të zinj, të cilët ne ua kemi dhuruar gjatë mbrëmjes.

Mbi 150,000 njerëz shënuan në skulpturë, duke filluar me Kryetarin dhe Kryeministrin e vendit, më 17 shkurt 2008, ditën kur Kosova e shpalli pavarësinë e saj. Këto shkrime domethënëse u shndërruan në art. Mediat e mbuluan rreth e përqark botës.

Qindëra mija njerëz e përjetuan, miliona e panë në TV. CNN dhe rrjetet tjera të mëdha botërore e përcollën nga vendi i ngjarjes drejtpërdrejt. Skulptura doli të nesërmen në ballinën e The New York Times, dhe u përmend nëpër gazeta tjera madhore si The International Herald Tribune, The Observer, Sydney Herald, etj., derisa BBC, Spiegel Online dhe të tjera e vendosën edhe në websitet e tyre. Si rezultat, për një kohë të gjatë mediat botërore e emërtuan Kosovën shteti i posalindur (the newborn country).

Sot, kjo skulpturë njihet si Monumenti i Shpalljes së Pavarësisë së Kosovës.

Monumenti ngjyroset ndryshe çdo vit për Ditën e Pavarësisë, duke i dhënë çdo herë kuptim tjetër. Tematika e secilit vit e përmban një porosi që Kosova ia jep botës, duke e bërë pjesëmarrëse dhe kontribuese në ndodhitë globale.

Për pamjet ndër vite të monumentit NEWBORN, shih:
Monumenti i gjallë
Monumenti pranoi disa çmime në kategorinë e dizajnit nga festivalet kreative më prestigjoze në botë, në veçanti Luanin e Artë në Cannes, si dhe u paraqit në revistën AdWeek.

Qysh nga atëherë, NEWBORN vazhdon të jetë shenjë identifikuese e Prishtinës, duke u bërë monumenti më i vizituar dhe fotografuar në rajon. Sot njihet si atraksion turistik, vepër arti dhe monument i gjallë historik në një, duke e futur në mesin e pak objekteve të këtij lloji në botë.
Si i tillë, u paraqit në dy libra të shquara për dizajn:
Managing the Design Process - Terry Lee Stone
Graphic Design Referenced - Bryony Gomez-Palacio & Armin Vit

Së fundmi, NEWBORN u ekspozua në Muzeun e Dizajnit në Londër (The Design Museum), në ekspozitën Hope to Nope: Graphics and Politics 2008-18 (Grafikat dhe Politika 2008-18) nga marsi në gusht të 2018, në mesin e punëve më kreative me ndikim politik në botë.
Më shumë për ekspozitën këtu.
NEWBORN është bërë isnpirim për shumë, në mesin e tyre ilustruesin e shquar Ricardo Cabral dhe entuziastin e sporteve ekstreme Snownjeri.
